verification_note: On 2026-09-29 the build sandbox's network policy blocked direct fetches of developers.google.com, support.google.com, developers.facebook.com, ads.tiktok.com, businesshelp.snapchat.com and docs.salla.dev. Rules marked verification_method=web_search_excerpt were confirmed against excerpts of the listed official page returned by web search, not by reading the full page. Rules with confidence=unconfirmed are enforced only as manual-check advisories until a maintainer confirms them (see knowledge/REVIEW_PROCESS.md).

rules.title: purchase requires transaction_id
rules.statement: The purchase event requires a transaction_id parameter (unique ID for the transaction).

rules.title: transaction_id must not be an empty string
rules.statement: Do not send an empty string as transaction_id: Google Analytics deduplicates all purchase events that have transaction_id="".

rules.title: transaction_id must be unique per order (dynamic)
rules.statement: Transaction IDs must be unique for each transaction; sending the same ID for different transactions can significantly undercount. GA4 deduplicates purchase events with the same transaction ID (web streams).
rules.notes: A static ID can only be proven by observing two different orders; a single test order cannot prove uniqueness.

rules.title: currency required when value is set
rules.statement: currency (3-letter ISO 4217) is required if value is set on ecommerce events.

rules.title: each item needs item_id or item_name
rules.statement: In the items array, one of item_id or item_name is required for each item.

rules.title: ecommerce events carry an items array
rules.statement: The ecommerce events view_item, add_to_cart, view_cart, begin_checkout, add_payment_info and purchase carry the products in an items array.
rules.notes: Search excerpts confirm items is the product container for these events; the per-event 'required' column of the reference table could not be read directly. Treated as manual-check until confirmed.

rules.title: event currency should match the store's configured currency
rules.statement: The currency sent should be the currency the store actually prices in. The auditor compares against the currency observed on the storefront (structured data / agent-recorded store settings); it never forces SAR.
rules.notes: Derived: ISO 4217 currency is required; which currency is correct is a store fact.

rules.title: purchase should be sent once per order
rules.statement: A single order should produce one purchase event per GA4 property. GA4 web streams deduplicate identical transaction IDs, but duplicate hits without a stable transaction_id inflate revenue.

rules.title: one page_view per page load per property
rules.statement: Two page_view hits to the same measurement ID in one page load indicate two competing implementations (e.g. gtag directly and via GTM / Salla integration).
rules.notes: Inference, not a documented rule: reported with certainty=inferred.

rules.title: a container should load once per page
rules.statement: Loading the same GTM container twice (e.g. theme code plus Salla GTM integration) duplicates every tag it fires.
rules.notes: Observation-based; multiple *different* containers can be intentional and are reported as inference.

rules.title: publishing a workspace is a write
rules.statement: Publishing (Submit -> Publish and Create Version) makes workspace changes live. It is a write operation and needs explicit approval. Preview mode tests the draft before publishing.

rules.title: Salla GTM integration via Container ID
rules.statement: Salla connects GTM by installing the Google Tag Manager integration and entering the Container ID.
rules.notes: Exact dashboard menu labels must be confirmed live before any write.

rules.title: purchase conversions pass transaction-specific value and currency
rules.statement: Pass the conversion value dynamically as a number (period decimal) and currency as ISO 4217 at runtime.
rules.notes: A constant value across different carts is only provable with two different observations.

rules.title: transaction_id minimises duplicate conversions
rules.statement: Include a unique transaction ID on the conversion so Google Ads can deduplicate repeated conversions for the same order.

rules.title: conversion event targets AW-ID/label
rules.statement: The gtag conversion event uses send_to 'AW-CONVERSION_ID/CONVERSION_LABEL'.

rules.title: enhanced conversions (user-provided data)
rules.statement: Enhanced conversions for web can be set up via the Google tag or GTM (automatic detection, CSS selectors/JS variables, or code). From April 2026 Google Ads uses a unified user-provided data setting.
rules.notes: Reported as information only; whether user data is sent is only partly observable client-side.

rules.title: Purchase requires currency and value
rules.statement: For the Purchase standard event, currency and value are required.

rules.title: catalog ads need contents or content_ids
rules.statement: For Advantage+ catalog ads, either contents or content_ids is required on commerce events; content_type (product | product_group) must match the ID type.
rules.notes: Only an issue if the merchant runs catalog ads; reported as medium with that condition.

rules.title: browser/server deduplication via eventID + event name
rules.statement: Pixel eventID must match Conversions API event_id and the event names must match; identical pairs received for the same pixel within 48 hours are deduplicated. Deduplication does not work with a single source.
rules.notes: Server events are not observable from the browser; only presence of eventID on browser events is checked.

rules.title: a browser event should fire once per action
rules.statement: Two browser hits of the same event to the same pixel for one action (different or missing eventID) indicate duplicate implementations.
rules.notes: Inference from observed traffic.

rules.title: Purchase is the current purchase event
rules.statement: TikTok's current standard event for a completed purchase is Purchase; CompletePayment was renamed to Purchase and PlaceAnOrder is soft-deprecated.
rules.notes: Rename details came partly from non-official excerpts; legacy names are accepted as purchase events and flagged as manual-check only.

rules.title: value and currency for ROAS
rules.statement: value is required for ROAS and value-based optimization; currency is required for ROAS.

rules.title: content_id for catalog / shopping ads
rules.statement: Commerce events should include content_id (and content_type) so they can be matched to catalog products.
rules.notes: Parameter list confirmed (content_id, content_type, currency, value); the catalog requirement wording needs manual confirmation.

rules.title: pixel/Events API deduplication via event_id
rules.statement: When the same event is sent by Pixel and Events API, a shared event_id lets TikTok deduplicate it.
rules.notes: Events API traffic is server-side and not observable from the browser.

rules.title: PURCHASE parameters
rules.statement: PURCHASE should carry transaction_id (unique per order), price, currency (ISO 4217), item_ids and number_items; currency, price and transaction_id are needed for accurate ROAS reporting.
rules.notes: Snap labels transaction_id, item_ids and number_items as mandatory and price/currency as recommended; ROAS needs currency+price+transaction_id.

rules.title: client_dedup_id for pixel + Conversions API
rules.statement: client_dedup_id is a UUID unique to an event, used when also sending via Conversions API or another direct integration.

rules.title: Snap standard event names
rules.statement: Standard events include PAGE_VIEW, VIEW_CONTENT, ADD_CART, START_CHECKOUT and PURCHASE, sent with snaptr('track', ...) after snaptr('init', PIXEL_ID) from sc-static.net/scevent.min.js.

rules.title: required product attributes
rules.statement: Required attributes (id, title, link, image_link, availability, price, and identifiers where applicable) must be submitted or the product cannot serve.

rules.title: price/availability must match the landing page
rules.statement: Google crawls landing pages and compares price/availability in product data with the page and its structured data; mismatches cause 'Mismatched value (page crawl)' issues.
rules.notes: Issue behaviour confirmed via community excerpts referencing the official article; the official article text itself could not be read.

rules.title: Salla ecommerce event stream
rules.statement: Salla exposes ecommerce events to apps in Device Mode (storefront tracker) and Cloud Mode (server): Product Viewed, Product Added, Product Removed, Cart Viewed, Cart Updated, Checkout Started, Checkout Step Viewed/Completed, Payment Info Entered, Order Completed. Custom events use Salla.analytics.track(eventName, properties).
rules.notes: These are Salla app events, not GA4/Meta hits; they explain where platform events can originate.

rules.title: Twilight storefront SDK
rules.statement: Salla storefront themes use the Twilight JS SDK (cdn.salla.network/js/twilight/...) exposing window.salla.
rules.notes: Used to recognise a Salla storefront.

rules.title: storefront URL patterns
rules.statement: Product pages commonly end in /p<digits>; cart at /cart. These patterns are observed, not documented.
rules.notes: Hints only; the flow runner labels steps from what it actually did.

rules.title: checkout may require customer login (OTP)
rules.statement: Proceeding to checkout on a Salla store may require the shopper to log in with a one-time code. The auditor never enters OTPs; the step becomes USER_ACTION_REQUIRED.
rules.notes: Behaviour varies by store settings; treated as a possible blocker, never assumed.

rules.title: collection endpoints used for decoding
rules.statement: GA4: */g/collect?tid=G-...; Google Ads: /pagead/(viewthrough)conversion/<id>/ and /pagead/1p-conversion/<id>/ with label/value/currency_code/oid; Meta: facebook.com/tr with id/ev/cd[...]/eid; TikTok: analytics.tiktok.com/api/...; Snapchat: tr*.snapchat.com. Loaders: googletagmanager.com/gtm.js, /gtag/js, connect.facebook.net fbevents.js, analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel/events.js, sc-static.net/scevent.min.js.
rules.notes: Wire formats are not formally specified by vendors. GA4/Ads/Meta decoding is high-confidence; TikTok and Snapchat payload decoding is best-effort and undecodable hits are reported as UNPARSED, never guessed.
